 PRESENTED BY 
 Stan Becton | NCAA.com | October 24, 2026
 Tracking undefeated FBS college football teams in the 2026 season
 How the College Football Playoff format will work in 2026-27 
 Share 
 Going into this season, 136 teams had the opportunity to complete the perfect season. In Week 8, there are FOUR  undefeated teams remaining. Indiana was the last team remaining last season, running the table at 16-0 to win the CFP title. 
 Will 2026 see a team join the Hoosiers and 2023 Michigan and make it four out of the last five national champions to finish with perfect seasons?  We're tracking every undefeated team here.
 *All results updated through Week 7. Rankings are from the AP Top 25 Poll 
 No. 1 Miami (Fla.) (6-0)
 Previous:   43-35 over  Florida State 
 Up next:   10/24 — vs. Pittsburgh 
 Last undefeated season:   2001 |12-0 | BCS Champions
 Miami survived its closest call yet, defeating unranked rival Florida State in double overtime. The win kept the Hurricanes undefeated and launched them to the No. 1 spot for the first time since 2002.
 No. 2 BYU (6-0)
 Previous:   28-24 over No. 2 Notre Dame 
 Up next:   10/24 — at UCF 
 Last undefeated season: 1984 | 13-0 | Consensus National Champions (AP, FWAA, NFF, USA/CNN, UPI)
 BYU is undefeated after one season after finishing as Big 12 runner-up. The Cougars won a battle of undefeated teams, taking down then-No. 2 Notre Dame in a last-minute thriller. It was the final nonconference game BYU will play this season, as the Cougars face Big 12 opponents the rest of the way.
 No. 9 UCLA (6-0)
 Previous:   17-7 over Wisconsin 
 Up next:   10/24 — vs. Michigan State  
 Last undefeated season: 1954 | 9-0 | National Champions (UPI, FWAA)
 UCLA's statement win of the season has been going into Eugene to beat Oregon for the first time since 2004. The Bruins have only one ranked opponent left on the schedule, a season finale against crosstown rival Southern California.
 No. 10 Utah (6-0)
 Previous:   27-24 over Colorado 
 Up next:   10/24 — vs. No. 20 Houston 
 Last undefeated season: 2008 | 13-0 | Sugar Bowl win
 Utah beat Colorado by only three in its last outing, a stark contrast for a team that had previously won by no fewer than 14 points this season. A lookahead at the remaining games show intriguing matchups with Houston and BYU.

He has covered numerous NCAA championship events, including the FCS Championship, DI Track & Field Championships and Men's Frozen Four. Additionally, he has covered the College Football Playoff and HBCU sporting events like the Celebration Bowl, MEAC/SWAC Challenge and Legacy Classic. Stan graduated from Carnegie Mellon University, earning a degree in Professional Writing and playing football as a five-year letterman. You can follow him on Twitter @stan_becton .
